metadata.title: The Green Ribbon — A2
metadata.synopsis: Após uma tempestade, Eva encontra sinais que levam a duas rotas de resgate em uma clínica evacuada.
metadata.author: English Roulette — rascunho com assistência de IA
metadata.attribution: Texto original de exemplo para revisão editorial. Arte e narração ainda não produzidas.

scenes.title: The Quiet Room
scenes.narration: Eva opens her eyes in a small clinic. Rain taps on the window, but the room is empty. Her orange jacket is beside the bed. A green ribbon hangs from the door. A card says, "Green marks the safe way. The storm is over." Eva puts on her jacket and follows the ribbon into the hall.
scenes.prompt: What does the green ribbon mark?
scenes.explanation: The card says that green marks the safe way.

transitions.label: Follow the ribbon into the hall

scenes.title: A Voice on the Radio
scenes.narration: The hall is dark, but Eva can see two signs: GARDEN and ROOF. A small radio is on a desk. A voice says, "The rescue team is checking the garden and the roof." Beside the garden door, a key hangs on a green hook. The stairs to the roof are open. Eva must choose where to look first.
scenes.explanation: The narration says that the key hangs on a green hook beside the garden door.

transitions.label: Take the key and open the garden door
Walk up the stairs to the roof

scenes.title: The Garden Gate
scenes.narration: Eva takes the key from the green hook and opens the garden door. The air smells fresh after the rain. Green ribbons lead to a wide gate. A rescue driver is waiting beside a yellow van. "We checked every room before the storm," he says. "I am glad you found our signs." Eva climbs into the van, ready to go home.
scenes.prompt: Who is waiting beside the yellow van?
scenes.explanation: A rescue driver is waiting beside the yellow van at the garden gate.

scenes.title: The Blue Button
scenes.narration: Eva walks up the stairs and steps onto the roof. The clouds are moving away. Near a bench, she finds a radio with a blue button. A green ribbon is tied around it. A note says, "Press the blue button if you need help." Eva presses it. A rescue worker answers and comes to meet her on the stairs. She is safe.
scenes.prompt: What does Eva press to ask for help?
scenes.explanation: The note tells Eva to press the blue button if she needs help.
